Data extraction: nginx config directives as KeyValue nodes

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ProcessConfig, process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack";
function main() {
  const config: ProcessConfig = { dataExtraction: true, language: "nginx" };
  const result = process("worker_processes 4;\nerror_log /var/log/nginx/error.log;\n", config);
  console.log(result.data);
  console.log(result.data?.kind);
}

void main();
```
